stages.whoA: His partner in crime, whom he kills to win his way into Wakanda.
stages.whoB: His partner, who kills him to win his way into Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi wants justice for his parents, whom Ulysses Klaue killed, so when Erik Killmonger arrives in Wakanda with Klaue's body, W'Kabi brings him before the council. He backs Erik as king and leads the Border Tribe in Erik's fight against T'Challa.
stages.whoA: The Border Tribe leader who backs him as king.
stages.whoB: The man who brings him Klaue's body, whom he backs as king.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zuri watched Killmonger's father N'Jobu die and helped T'Chaka keep it secret. When Killmonger comes to Wakanda, Zuri steps in to protect T'Challa and Killmonger kills him.
stages.whoA: The elder who hid his father's death, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: N'Jobu's son, who kills him as he protects T'Challa.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sersi visits Kingo on his film set in Mumbai to recruit him. He travels with her but refuses to fight in the final battle.
stages.whoA: The Eternal who recruits him from his film set.
stages.whoB: A fellow Eternal she recruits, who refuses to fight in the end.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite is Kingo's close friend. Kingo refuses to fight her or anyone else in the final battle.
stages.whoA: His close friend, whom he refuses to fight.
stages.whoB: Her close friend, who refuses to fight her.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie is Matt Murdock's law partner at Murdock & McDuffie and his best friend. She watches over him after Foggy's death.
stages.whoA: Her law partner and best friend, whom she watches over after Foggy.
stages.whoB: His law partner and best friend, who watches over him after Foggy dies.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie represents Soledad Ayala's husband Hector and supports her through his trial.
stages.whoA: Her client's wife, whom she supports through Hector's trial.
stages.whoB: Her husband's lawyer, who supports her through his trial.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie, Matt's partner at Murdock and McDuffie, takes on the cases that put her against Mayor Fisk's anti-vigilante crackdown.
stages.whoA: The mayor whose anti-vigilante crackdown she fights in court.
stages.whoB: A lawyer whose cases challenge his anti-vigilante crackdown.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Fisk strikes back by raiding her law office and freezing its accounts. She works with Matt to find witnesses who can prove Fisk's crimes and remove him from office.
stages.whoA: The mayor who raids her office and whom she works to remove.
stages.whoB: A lawyer whose office he raids, who hunts witnesses against him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: While on the run, Trish breaks into Jeri Hogarth's apartment and holds Kith Lyonne hostage to force Jeri to help her escape.
stages.whoA: Jessica's sister, who holds her hostage to force Jeri's help.
stages.whoB: Jeri's love, whom she holds hostage to force Jeri's help.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox is the enforcer who guards Sonny Burch during his black-market deal with Hope van Dyne at his restaurant. He stays at Burch's side as his boss tries to steal Hank Pym's lab.
stages.whoA: His boss, whom he guards as enforcer.
stages.whoB: His enforcer, who guards him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox and Uzman work side by side in Sonny Burch's crew. Together they take Luis, Kurt and Dave hostage at X-Con Security so Uzman can dose Luis with his truth serum.
stages.whoA: A fellow crewman in Burch's gang.
stages.whoB: A fellow crewman in Burch's gang.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Korath and Minn-Erva are teammates in Starforce, the Kree strike team led by Yon-Rogg. They fight side by side on the mission to Torfa and then follow Yon-Rogg to Earth to hunt down Carol Danvers.
stages.whoA: A fellow Starforce member who hunts Carol with him.
stages.whoB: A fellow Starforce member who hunts Carol with her.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Korath chases Peter Quill for the Orb on Morag, and they try to kill each other.
stages.whoA: The thief he chases for the Orb on Morag.
stages.whoB: Ronan's hunter, who chases him for the Orb on Morag to kill him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Korath the Pursuer leaves Starforce to become Ronan the Accuser's loyal enforcer. Ronan sends him to Morag for the Orb, and Korath stays at his side on the Dark Aster until Drax kills him.
stages.whoA: His master, who sends him to Morag for the Orb.
stages.whoB: His loyal enforcer, whom he sends after the Orb.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Korath serves in Starforce under Yon-Rogg's command during the Kree war with the Skrulls. Yon-Rogg leads him and the team to Torfa to rescue the Kree spy Soh-Larr, and later to Earth to bring back Carol Danvers.
stages.whoA: His Starforce commander.
stages.whoB: A Starforce soldier under his command.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Miek is Korg's best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and they escape with Thor together.
stages.whoA: Best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and a fellow escapee.
stages.whoB: Best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and a fellow escapee.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Korg is one of the Grandmaster's gladiators who starts a revolution against him.
stages.whoA: His master, against whom he leads a revolution.
stages.whoB: One of his gladiators, who starts a revolution against him.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Korg befriends Thor in the gladiator pits of Sakaar and joins his revolt against the Grandmaster.
stages.whoA: A friend from the pits whose revolt he joins.
stages.whoB: A friend from the pits who joins his revolt.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Korg follows Thor to New Asgard and fights at his side again against Gorr, even after Zeus blasts his body apart.
stages.whoA: His friend, whom he follows to New Asgard and fights beside.
stages.whoB: His friend, who fights beside him against Gorr even after losing his body.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Korg and Valkyrie both join Thor's revolt on Sakaar and settle in New Asgard with the surviving Asgardians. They fight side by side against Gorr.
stages.whoA: A friend from Sakaar who fights beside him against Gorr.
stages.whoB: A friend from Sakaar who fights beside her against Gorr.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Zeus throws his thunderbolt at Korg in Omnipotence City, blowing apart Korg's body and leaving only his head.
stages.whoA: The god who blasts his body apart.
stages.whoB: A Kronan he blasts apart with his thunderbolt.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Taserface's mutiny, Kraglin fits Nebula with a new cybernetic hand and gives her a ship so she can hunt down Gamora on Ego's planet.
stages.whoA: Gamora's sister, whom he fits with a hand and a ship.
stages.whoB: A Ravager who gives her a new hand and a ship to hunt Gamora.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is a Ravager on the crew of Yondu Udonta, who raised Quill, and he flies with the Ravagers beside the Guardians at the Battle of Xandar.
stages.whoA: The boy Yondu raised, whom he flies beside at Xandar.
stages.whoB: A Ravager from the crew that raised him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Yondu's death, Kraglin joins the Guardians and becomes Quill's friend.
stages.whoA: His friend and new teammate.
stages.whoB: A new Guardian and friend after Yondu's death.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: During Taserface's mutiny, Kraglin helps Rocket and Yondu break free and retake the ship.
stages.whoA: The Guardian he helps break free from Taserface.
stages.whoB: A Ravager who helps him and Yondu retake the ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Years later, Kraglin is part of the new Guardians team that Rocket leads.
stages.whoA: His leader on the new Guardians.
stages.whoB: A Guardian on the team he leads.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Kraglin sits with Taserface as he grumbles that Yondu has gone soft, and the talk turns into a mutiny. When Taserface executes Yondu's loyal crew, Kraglin regrets it and helps Yondu and Rocket break free and destroy Taserface's ship.
stages.whoA: The Ravager whose mutiny he regrets helping start.
stages.whoB: A Ravager who joins his mutiny, then turns on him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kraglin pilots Knowhere through a jump point to the High Evolutionary's Arête Laboratories, arriving to his horror to help the Guardians rescue their friends and the captive children.
stages.whoA: The madman whose lab he flies Knowhere into.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who pilots Knowhere into his lab.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is Yondu's first mate in the Ravagers, at his side on the hunt for Peter Quill and the Orb.
stages.whoA: His captain, whom he serves as first mate.
stages.whoB: His first mate in the Ravagers.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Kraglin regrets his part in Taserface's mutiny against Yondu and helps him break free. After Yondu's death, Quill gives Kraglin his Yaka Arrow.
stages.whoA: His captain, whom he helps free and whose arrow he inherits.
stages.whoB: His first mate, who regrets the mutiny and later inherits his arrow.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: In the Amazon, Makkari races circles around Kro to stop him, but he catches her and nearly kills her. Thena steps in to save her and finishes him off.
stages.whoA: An Eternal he catches and nearly kills in the Amazon.
stages.whoB: The Deviant who catches her and nearly kills her.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Kro is the Deviant leader who attacks Sersi in London and keeps hunting the Eternals.
stages.whoA: An Eternal he attacks in London.
stages.whoB: The Deviant leader who attacks her in London.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Kro hunts Sprite through London, seeing through the illusions she uses to hide and nearly absorbing her powers. Ikaris arrives just in time to blast him away.
stages.whoA: An Eternal he hunts through London and nearly drains.
stages.whoB: The Deviant who sees through her illusions and nearly drains her.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Kro kills Gilgamesh as he defends Thena, then taunts her with the powers he absorbed from him. Thena avenges Gilgamesh by killing Kro.
stages.whoA: The Eternal he taunts after killing Gilgamesh, who kills him.
stages.whoB: The Deviant who kills Gilgamesh, whom she kills in revenge.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Kuda is Prince Tafari's partner in the War Dogs, and they go on a mission to 1896 Ethiopia together.
stages.whoA: His War Dogs partner on the 1896 mission.
stages.whoB: His War Dogs partner on the 1896 mission.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: The Black Panther of the future travels back to 1896 to stop a vibranium axe from being recovered, and she clashes with Kuda.
stages.whoA: The future Black Panther who clashes with him in 1896.
stages.whoB: A War Dog she clashes with in 1896.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Kurse fatally stabs Loki, or so it seems, and Loki kills him with one of his own grenades.
stages.whoA: The trickster he seems to kill, who kills him with a grenade.
stages.whoB: Malekith's lieutenant, who stabs him and dies by his grenade.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Kurse is Algrim, Malekith's loyal lieutenant, who turns himself into a Kursed warrior for him.
stages.whoA: His master, for whom he becomes a Kursed warrior.
stages.whoB: His loyal lieutenant, who becomes Kursed for him.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Kurse, Malekith's lieutenant, breaks into Asgard's palace and kills Thor's mother, Frigga. Thor fights him on Svartalfheim, where Loki kills Kurse with his own black hole grenade.
stages.whoA: The prince he fights on Svartalfheim.
stages.whoB: The Kursed warrior who kills his mother, Frigga.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Kurt and Luis are partners on the crew that recruits Scott for the heist at Hank Pym's house.
stages.whoA: His partner on the crew that recruits Scott.
stages.whoB: His partner on the crew that recruits Scott.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Kurt is the crew's hacker, just out of Folsom Prison when Luis introduces him to Scott. He helps Scott break into Hank Pym's house.
stages.whoA: The man he helps break into Pym's house.
stages.whoB: His crew's hacker, who helps him break into Pym's house.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Sonny Burch and his men storm X-Con Security and tie up Kurt while they interrogate Luis about Scott's location. Kurt later frees himself and, with Dave, takes Burch's crew down with tasers before handing them to the police.
stages.whoA: The arms dealer who ties him up, whose crew he takes down.
stages.whoB: A crew member he ties up, who takes his men down with tasers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter goes on the run with Fitz and Coulson when Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. takes over, and the two become good friends.
stages.whoA: A good friend he goes on the run with from Gonzales.
stages.whoB: A good friend he goes on the run with from Gonzales.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Years later, Hunter breaks Fitz out of military custody and takes him to Enoch so he can follow his friends into the future.
stages.whoA: His friend, whom he breaks out of custody to follow the team.
stages.whoB: His friend, who breaks him out of military custody.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter fights beside May on Coulson's team, and the two become friends.
stages.whoA: A teammate and friend on Coulson's team.
stages.whoB: A teammate and friend on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When Hunter wants revenge on Grant Ward for hurting Bobbi, he pulls May out of her retirement to help him hunt Ward down.
stages.whoA: A friend he pulls out of retirement to hunt Ward.
stages.whoB: A friend who pulls her out of retirement to hunt Ward.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Deathlok rescues Lance Hunter and Coulson from Robert Gonzales' agents by seizing their Quinjet, to Hunter's shock, since Coulson never told him their backup was a cyborg. The three then fly off to pick up Fitz and plot a way into Hydra.
stages.whoA: The cyborg backup who rescues him by seizing a Quinjet.
stages.whoB: An agent he rescues, shocked to learn the backup is a cyborg.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Lance Hunter as a mercenary, and Hunter becomes one of his most loyal agents. When Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. takes over, Hunter goes on the run with Coulson and hides out with him at the Retreat.
stages.whoA: The director who recruits him and whom he follows on the run.
stages.whoB: A mercenary he recruits, who becomes one of his most loyal agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter mocks Raina when she comes begging S.H.I.E.L.D. for protection, but he still helps guard her from Hydra in Vancouver. Earlier, his attempt to kill Carl Creel creates the chaos Raina uses to slip away with the Diviner.
stages.whoA: A seer he mocks but helps guard from Hydra.
stages.whoB: An agent who mocks her but helps guard her in Vancouver.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When Lance Hunter is brought aboard Robert Gonzales' carrier, Gonzales tries to win him over, but Hunter calls him crazy and stays loyal to Coulson. Hunter then goes on the run with Coulson to escape Gonzales' agents.
stages.whoA: The rival director he calls crazy and runs from.
stages.whoB: An agent he tries to win over, who stays loyal to Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lance Hunter and Coulson try to catch Rosalind Price alone on a subway train, but she has set a trap and her ATCU agents handcuff them. Hunter later spies on her agency with Bobbi Morse.
stages.whoA: The ATCU chief who traps him, and whose agency he later spies on.
stages.whoB: An agent she traps on a subway, who later spies on her agency.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Victor Ramon arrests Lance Hunter alongside Bobbi Morse after Lucio paralyzes them, and he uses Hunter's life as leverage to make Bobbi talk.
stages.whoA: The police chief who arrests him and uses his life as leverage.
stages.whoB: An agent he arrests and uses as leverage against Bobbi.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Landon is a kid in Riri's Chicago neighborhood. He hauls her wrecked armor home in his wagon, and later charges her to borrow it.
stages.whoA: A neighbor whose armor he hauls home, then charges her to borrow.
stages.whoB: A neighborhood kid who hauls her armor home, then charges her for it.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Laufey, king of the Frost Giants, is Loki's birth father. Loki kills him as part of a scheme to win Odin's approval.
stages.whoA: His birth son, who kills him.
stages.whoB: His birth father, the Frost Giant king, whom he kills.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Laufey is Odin's old enemy. Loki lets him into Asgard to kill Odin in his sleep.
stages.whoA: His old enemy, whom he tries to kill in his sleep.
stages.whoB: His old enemy, who sneaks into Asgard to kill him.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Laufey's Frost Giants attack the Warriors Three when they follow Thor into Jotunheim, and the fight only ends when Odin arrives. Laufey's taunt about traitors in Odin's house later leads Hogun to suspect Loki.
stages.whoA: The warriors his Frost Giants fight in Jotunheim.
stages.whoB: The Frost Giant king, whose giants they fight in Jotunheim.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Thor leads a reckless raid on Jotunheim and battles Laufey's Frost Giants until Odin pulls him out. Laufey later comes to Asgard to kill Odin, and Loki kills him.
stages.whoA: The prince who raids his realm.
stages.whoB: The Frost Giant king, whom he battles in a reckless raid.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Lila is Laura's daughter, raised with her brothers on the Barton family farm.
stages.whoA: Her daughter.
stages.whoB: Her mother.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Laura and Lila vanish together in the Snap and return together after the Blip.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, who vanishes in the Snap with her and returns.
stages.whoB: Her mother, who vanishes with her in the Snap and returns with her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Natasha is one of the few people who know about Clint's secret family, and she and Laura become close friends. Laura welcomes her as an honorary aunt to the children and plans to name her third child after her.
stages.whoA: A close friend, honorary aunt to her children.
stages.whoB: A close friend, Clint's wife, who makes her an honorary aunt.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Nathaniel is Laura's youngest child, born after the fight against Ultron. She and Clint first expect a girl they plan to call Natasha, then name their son Nathaniel instead.
stages.whoA: Her youngest son.
stages.whoB: His mother.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Laura Barton is a former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, and when she retires Nick Fury erases her from the agency's files to protect her family. Fury later turns up at the Barton farm to rally the Avengers against Ultron.
stages.whoA: Her former director, who erased her from the files.
stages.whoB: A former agent he erased from the files to protect her family.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Layla El-Faouly is Marc Spector's wife. He hides his life as Moon Knight from her, and she finally fights beside him as the Scarlet Scarab.
stages.whoA: Her husband, who hides his Moon Knight life until she fights beside him.
stages.whoB: His wife, who learns his secret and fights beside him as Scarlet Scarab.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Taweret makes Layla her temporary avatar, giving her the powers of the Scarlet Scarab.
stages.whoA: The goddess who makes her the Scarlet Scarab.
stages.whoB: Her temporary avatar, the Scarlet Scarab.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Leap-Frog sues Luke Jacobson over a faulty suit, and after losing the case he kidnaps Luke.
stages.whoA: The tailor he sues, then kidnaps.
stages.whoB: A client who sues him over a faulty suit, then kidnaps him.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt Murdock is Luke Jacobson's lawyer against Leap-Frog. Then as Daredevil he fights Leap-Frog's men to rescue Luke.
stages.whoA: The tailor's lawyer, who as Daredevil fights his men.
stages.whoB: His client's opponent, whose men he fights as Daredevil.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Leet Brannis is the Leviathan agent selling Howard Stark's Nitramene, and he blows up the Roxxon refinery to escape Peggy Carter. She later catches him, and before he dies he draws her Leviathan's symbol.
stages.whoA: The agent he blows up a refinery to escape, who catches him.
stages.whoB: The Leviathan agent who flees her, then draws her its symbol.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sasha Demidov and Leet Brannis join Leviathan together. Demidov later kills Brannis.
stages.whoA: A fellow Leviathan recruit, who later kills him.
stages.whoB: A fellow Leviathan recruit, whom he later kills.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Leet Brannis sells Spider Raymond the formula for Howard Stark's Nitramene at Raymond's club, La Martinique. The deal leads a Leviathan assassin straight to Raymond.
stages.whoA: A club owner he sells the Nitramene formula to.
stages.whoB: The man who sells him the Nitramene formula.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Leland Owlsley works with Madame Gao in Fisk's alliance. The two of them plot to poison Vanessa.
stages.whoA: A partner in Fisk's alliance, with whom he plots to poison Vanessa.
stages.whoB: A partner in Fisk's alliance, with whom she plots to poison Vanessa.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Leland Owlsley and Nobu Yoshioka are partners in Wilson Fisk's criminal alliance and meet with the others to talk business. Waiting on a freezing rooftop, Leland complains that Nobu's calm is unsettling and asks him to at least pretend to be cold.
stages.whoA: A partner whose calm on a cold rooftop unsettles him.
stages.whoB: A partner who asks him to at least pretend to be cold.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Leland Owlsley and Madame Gao arrange for Vanessa to be poisoned at a fundraiser, hoping to pull her away from Fisk. She survives.
stages.whoA: Fisk's love, whom he helps poison to pull her from Fisk.
stages.whoB: Wilson's money man, who has her poisoned at a fundraiser.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Leland Owlsley handles the money for Fisk's alliance. After he steals from Fisk and helps arrange Vanessa's poisoning, Fisk throws him down an elevator shaft.
stages.whoA: His partner, who throws him down an elevator shaft.
stages.whoB: His money man, who steals from him and is thrown down a shaft.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Lemar Hoskins works alongside Sam Wilson during the hunt for the Flag Smashers, though the two disagree about Walker's methods.
stages.whoA: An ally on the Flag Smashers hunt, at odds with him over Walker.
stages.whoB: Battlestar, an ally on the Flag Smashers hunt, at odds with him over Walker.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Lorelei enchants Fitz when she and Grant Ward take over the Bus, and he locks Jemma Simmons and Skye away for her. Fitz also repairs the Asgardian collar Sif needs to restrain her.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian who enchants him, whose collar he repairs.
stages.whoB: A scientist she enchants, who repairs the collar that restrains her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May picks Fitz for Coulson's team and keeps pushing the lab engineer to get his hands dirty in the field. They grow close over the years.
stages.whoA: The agent who picks him for the team and pushes him into the field.
stages.whoB: The engineer she picks for the team and pushes into the field.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: After years apart from the team, Fitz reunites with May and the others in 1983 and helps them finish their mission against the Chronicoms.
stages.whoA: An old friend he reunites with in 1983 to finish the mission.
stages.whoB: An old friend who rejoins her in 1983 against the Chronicoms.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Fitz helps save Mike Peterson when the Centipede serum is about to make him explode.
stages.whoA: A man he helps save from exploding Centipede serum.
stages.whoB: A scientist who helps keep the Centipede serum from making him explode.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After Mike breaks free of HYDRA's control as Deathlok, Fitz and Jemma repair his cybernetic parts, and he becomes a friend to the team.
stages.whoA: Deathlok, a friend whose cybernetics he repairs.
stages.whoB: A friend who repairs his cybernetic parts.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Nick Fury runs S.H.I.E.L.D. when Fitz joins Coulson's team, and he grumbles about the fish tank FitzSimmons want to put on the Bus. When Grant Ward dumps Fitz and Jemma Simmons into the ocean, Fury pulls them out and saves their lives.
stages.whoA: The head of S.H.I.E.L.D., who pulls him out of the ocean.
stages.whoB: One of Coulson's scientists, whom he pulls from the ocean.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Fitz and Jemma Simmons to his team, and the young engineer becomes one of his most loyal agents and friends. Fitz builds much of the gear Coulson relies on, like the Night-Night Pistol, and stays at his side when Coulson becomes Director.
stages.whoA: His team leader and friend, for whom he builds gear.
stages.whoB: One of his most loyal agents and friends, who builds his gear.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Piper is one of the agents who pull Fitz out of the chamber where he has trapped Aida.
stages.whoA: An agent who helps pull him out of Aida's chamber.
stages.whoB: A scientist she helps pull from the chamber where he traps Aida.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Piper joins Daisy and Jemma on the long search through space to bring Fitz home.
stages.whoA: A friend who joins the long search through space for him.
stages.whoB: A friend she searches space for with Daisy and Jemma.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Robbie Reyes, the Ghost Rider, saves Fitz at Momentum Labs when the ghost Frederick is about to kill him, burning Frederick away. Later Fitz is caught with Robbie and Coulson in Eli Morrow's explosion, which nearly traps them in another dimension.
stages.whoA: Ghost Rider, who saves him from the ghost Frederick.
stages.whoB: A scientist he saves from a ghost, then nearly gets trapped with.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales once hoped to recruit Fitz and Jemma Simmons out of the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy, but Coulson got to them first. When Gonzales' faction storms the Playground, Fitz goes on the run with Coulson and Lance Hunter.
stages.whoA: The rival director who once hoped to recruit him.
stages.whoB: A scientist he once hoped to recruit, who runs from him with Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand runs the Hub and sends Fitz and Grant Ward into South Ossetia to disable the Overkill Device. She keeps from them that no extraction team is coming, which Coulson calls her out on.
stages.whoA: The Hub's chief, who sends him on a mission with no extraction.
stages.whoB: An engineer she sends to South Ossetia without an extraction team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Leo Fitz blasts Vin-Tak across the room with the Destroyer gun, giving Bobbi Morse the chance to turn the Kree's own truncheon against him.
stages.whoA: A Kree warrior he blasts across the room.
stages.whoB: The scientist who blasts him with the Destroyer gun.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Lila calls Natasha "Auntie Nat." Natasha is a close friend of the Barton family and acts as an aunt to the children, and Lila runs to hug her when she visits the farm.
stages.whoA: Auntie Nat, her family's close friend.
stages.whoB: Clint's daughter, who calls her Auntie Nat.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Nathaniel is Lila's younger brother, born after the fight against Ultron. Lila is thrilled at the news that she is getting another brother.
stages.whoA: Her baby brother.
stages.whoB: His older sister.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Rio Vidal joins Lilia's coven on the Witches' Road posing as the Green Witch, though she is really Death. She later appears to Lilia in her true form, telling her all roads lead to her, and Lilia finally realizes who Rio is during the trial that ends her life.
stages.whoA: The coven's Green Witch, really Death, who comes for her in the end.
stages.whoB: A witch in her coven, whose life she comes to end.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell teams up with May to save Skye from Alisha Whitley's duplicates when Jiaying's Inhumans seize the Iliad.
stages.whoA: An agent he teams up with to save Skye on the Iliad.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman she teams up with to save Skye on the Iliad.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Deathlok and Lincoln Campbell clash when they first meet, with Lincoln refusing to believe Deathlok is Skye's friend. Both are then captured by Hydra and experimented on by Dr. List until Coulson's team rescues them.
stages.whoA: A cyborg he clashes with, then is held by Hydra beside.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman he clashes with, then is captured with by Hydra.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell first clashes with Phil Coulson over S.H.I.E.L.D. keeping records on Inhumans, which he compares to HYDRA.
stages.whoA: The director he compares to HYDRA over the Inhuman records.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who compares his record-keeping to HYDRA.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln joins Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. and its Secret Warriors, and in the end he gives his life to stop Hive.
stages.whoA: His director, whose team he joins before he dies stopping Hive.
stages.whoB: A Secret Warrior on his team, who gives his life to stop Hive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell looks after Raina at Afterlife as she struggles with her transformation and tries to comfort her. She confides in him about her vivid dreams of the future.
stages.whoA: A newly turned Inhuman he looks after at Afterlife.
stages.whoB: The Inhuman who comforts her at Afterlife and hears her dreams.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Rosalind Price's ATCU hunts Lincoln Campbell after his powers make him a target, and Coulson makes a deal to hand him over to her. Lincoln is angry and suspicious of Price even after Coulson insists she is on their side.
stages.whoA: The ATCU chief who hunts him, whom he never trusts.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman her agency hunts, who stays suspicious of her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell shocks Werner von Strucker's brain to unlock his memories for S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: A Hydra heir whose brain he shocks to unlock memories.
stages.whoB: The Inhuman who shocks his brain to unlock his memories.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Linda works with Ulysses Klaue on the museum heist. Klaue later uses her as a hostage.
stages.whoA: Her partner on the museum heist, who uses her as a hostage.
stages.whoB: His partner on the heist, whom he later uses as a hostage.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Lisa Molinari is Tommy's best friend and love interest. They escape a transfer to a psychiatric hospital together and spend a year as street thieves, and he later frees her from Jocasta's nanobot control.
stages.whoA: Her best friend and love interest, who frees her from Jocasta.
stages.whoB: His best friend and love interest, a fellow street thief.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Lisa Molinari becomes an ally of White Vision, the father figure of her best friend Tommy.
stages.whoA: Her best friend's father figure, whom she sides with.
stages.whoB: Tommy's best friend, who becomes his ally.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Peter Parker has a crush on Liz Allan and takes her to the homecoming dance, only to realize her father is the Vulture.
stages.whoA: The boy who takes her to homecoming.
stages.whoB: His crush, whom he takes to homecoming before learning who her father is.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington is Liz's teacher and oversees the academic decathlon team she captains. He is trapped with her in the falling Washington Monument elevator until Spider-Man saves them, and he names MJ captain once Liz leaves the school.
stages.whoA: Her teacher and decathlon coach, trapped with her in the elevator.
stages.whoB: His student and decathlon captain, trapped with him in the elevator.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Adrian Toomes, the Vulture, is Liz Allan's father. Peter Parker learns the truth when he picks Liz up for the homecoming dance.
stages.whoA: Her father.
stages.whoB: His daughter, whose homecoming date is Spider-Man.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Mr. Paradox of the TVA plans to destroy Deadpool's universe and drops Logan into the Void. Logan returns to stop him.
stages.whoA: The TVA agent who drops him into the Void.
stages.whoB: The Wolverine he drops into the Void, who comes back to stop him.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Loki wants revenge on Malekith for Frigga's death, and he joins Thor's mission to Svartalfheim. He fakes a betrayal to lure Malekith close to the Aether.
stages.whoA: His mother's killer, whom he lures close with a faked betrayal.
stages.whoB: Thor's brother, who fakes a betrayal to lure him in.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Miss Minutes greets Loki with the TVA's orientation video when he is first arrested. At the Citadel at the End of Time she tempts him with a deal to win in New York and take Asgard's throne.
stages.whoA: The TVA's cartoon guide, who later tempts him with a deal.
stages.whoB: A Variant she orients, then tempts with a deal at the Citadel.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Miss Minutes works against Loki at the TVA and sabotages his search for Victor Timely.
stages.whoA: The TVA's AI, who sabotages his search for Victor Timely.
stages.whoB: The Variant whose search for Victor Timely she sabotages.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Mobius M. Mobius is the TVA agent who brings Loki in and gives him a chance to change. Working cases together, the two become friends.
stages.whoA: The agent who brings him in and becomes his friend.
stages.whoB: The Variant he brings in and befriends while working cases.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Mobius is Loki's best friend as they try to save the failing Temporal Loom. In the end Loki takes the Loom's place at the End of Time.
stages.whoA: His best friend, with him to the end trying to save the Loom.
stages.whoB: His best friend, who takes the Loom's place at the End of Time.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff interrogates Loki in his cell on the Helicarrier, where he taunts her about Clint and her past. She tricks him into revealing that he plans to unleash the Hulk.
stages.whoA: The spy who tricks him into revealing his plan for the Hulk.
stages.whoB: The prisoner she interrogates and tricks into revealing his plan.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki steals the Tesseract from Nick Fury's S.H.I.E.L.D. base and nearly kills him in the escape. Fury later holds Loki in a glass cell on the Helicarrier, where Loki taunts him.
stages.whoA: The director whose Tesseract he steals.
stages.whoB: The god who steals the Tesseract and nearly kills him.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Odin takes in Loki as a baby and raises him as his own son. When Loki learns he is a Frost Giant, he schemes to prove himself to Odin and falls into space when Odin rejects him.
stages.whoA: His adoptive father, who raised him and then rejects him.
stages.whoB: His adopted son, a Frost Giant he raised as his own.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Odin locks Loki in Asgard's dungeons for his crimes on Earth. In the end Loki secretly takes Odin's place on the throne.
stages.whoA: His adoptive father, who jails him, and whose throne he secretly takes.
stages.whoB: His adopted son, whom he jails and who secretly takes his place.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Loki has left Odin stranded on Earth. When Thor and Loki find him in Norway, Odin tells his sons he loves them and dies.
stages.whoA: His adoptive father, who tells his sons he loves them and dies.
stages.whoB: His son, who stranded him on Earth, and whom he tells he loves.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Ouroboros, the TVA's repairman, helps Loki understand why he keeps slipping through time. The two work side by side to repair the failing Temporal Loom.
stages.whoA: The TVA repairman who helps him fix the Loom.
stages.whoB: A friend he works beside to repair the Temporal Loom.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki stabs Phil Coulson aboard the Helicarrier after Coulson tries to stop his escape. With his last strength, Coulson fires a prototype weapon that blasts Loki through a wall.
stages.whoA: The agent he stabs, who blasts him through a wall.
stages.whoB: The god who stabs him on the Helicarrier.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: President Loki is a Loki variant hiding out in the Void with Loki's band of fellow variants. He betrays the group to claim the Void for himself, turning his own army on Loki and the others.
stages.whoA: A rival variant who turns his army on him.
stages.whoB: A fellow variant he betrays to claim the Void.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Loki and Sif grow up fighting side by side as Thor's companions, but they never get along, and once Loki cuts off a lock of her hair as a prank. When Loki seizes the throne, Sif defies him and fights his Destroyer on Earth.
stages.whoA: Thor's companion he never gets along with, who defies his rule.
stages.whoB: Thor's brother, a fellow companion she never gets along with.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Loki, disguised as Odin, banishes Heimdall and puts Skurge in charge of the Bifrost, mostly so Skurge will warn him when Thor comes home. Skurge fails even at that, and loses the post once Loki is exposed.
stages.whoA: The man he puts in charge of the Bifrost while disguised as Odin.
stages.whoB: His boss, who gives him the Bifrost while posing as Odin.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki is the first enemy Steve Rogers faces as an Avenger, dueling him in Stuttgart and leading the Chitauri invasion of New York.
stages.whoA: The soldier he duels in Stuttgart.
stages.whoB: His first enemy as an Avenger.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Loki revives the fire demon Surtur by placing his crown in Asgard's Eternal Flame. Unleashing Surtur destroys Asgard and Hela along with it, just as Thor planned.
stages.whoA: The fire demon he revives to destroy Asgard and Hela.
stages.whoB: The god who revives him with his crown in the Eternal Flame.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Sylvie is a variant of Loki. They start out on opposite sides but fall for each other while running from the TVA. At the Citadel she kisses him, then sends him away through a time door and kills He Who Remains.
stages.whoA: His variant and love, who kisses him, then sends him away.
stages.whoB: Her variant, whom she falls for, then sends through a time door.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Loki finds Sylvie living a quiet life on her own and needs her help to save the TVA. They clash over whether to kill Victor Timely, and in the end Loki takes the Loom's place to protect the free multiverse she wanted.
stages.whoA: His love, whose free multiverse he gives himself up to protect.
stages.whoB: Her love, who takes the Loom's place to protect her free multiverse.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki leads the invasion of Earth on Thanos's behalf.
stages.whoA: His master, for whom he leads the invasion of Earth.
stages.whoB: The god who leads the invasion of Earth for him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos attacks the Asgardian refugee ship, and Loki hands over the Tesseract to save Thor. Then he tries to stab Thanos, and Thanos kills him.
stages.whoA: The titan who kills him.
stages.whoB: The god who hands over the Tesseract, then tries to stab him.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Loki wins the Grandmaster's favor on Sakaar and becomes part of his inner circle. He tries to sell Thor out for a reward but ends up abandoning the Grandmaster to help his brother.
stages.whoA: The ruler of Sakaar, whose favor he wins, then abandons.
stages.whoB: A favorite in his inner circle, who abandons him for his brother.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: The Other gives Loki his orders from Thanos for the invasion of Earth.
stages.whoA: Thanos's agent, who gives him his orders.
stages.whoB: The god he gives Thanos's orders for the invasion.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: The Warriors Three suspect Loki of treachery when he takes the throne, and they defy him by going to Earth to bring Thor home. Loki sends the Destroyer after them.
stages.whoA: Thor's friends, who defy him, so he sends the Destroyer after them.
stages.whoB: Thor's brother, whom they suspect, and who sends the Destroyer after them.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Loki is Thor's adopted brother, raised beside him on Asgard. Jealous of Thor and shaken to learn he is a Frost Giant, he seizes the throne while Thor is banished, and their fight on the Bifrost ends with Loki falling into space.
stages.whoA: His adopted brother, whose throne he seizes while he is banished.
stages.whoB: His adopted brother, who seizes the throne, then falls into space.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki returns to lead an invasion of Earth, and Thor fights him while still begging him to come home. After the Battle of New York, Thor takes him back to Asgard in chains.
stages.whoA: His brother, who fights him and takes him home in chains.
stages.whoB: His brother, who invades Earth while he begs him to come home.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Thor frees Loki from his cell to help avenge their mother, Frigga, and stop Malekith. Loki seems to die saving Thor on Svartalfheim.
stages.whoA: His brother, who frees him to avenge their mother.
stages.whoB: His brother, who helps avenge their mother and seems to die saving him.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Thor exposes Loki's rule in Odin's disguise, and after one more betrayal on Sakaar, Loki comes back to help save Asgard's people. The brothers finally stand together.
stages.whoA: His brother, at whose side he finally stands to save Asgard's people.
stages.whoB: His brother, who betrays him once more, then helps save their people.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Thanos attacks their ship, Loki dies trying to protect his brother.
stages.whoA: His brother, whom he dies trying to protect.
stages.whoB: His brother, who dies trying to protect him.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki tries to take control of Tony Stark with his scepter, but Tony's arc reactor blocks it, so Loki throws him out of Stark Tower. Tony then leads the fight against Loki's invasion of New York.
stages.whoA: The man he throws out of Stark Tower, who leads the fight against him.
stages.whoB: The god who throws him out of Stark Tower.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Topaz works with Loki while he is in the Grandmaster's favor, then hunts him when he flees.
stages.whoA: The Grandmaster's enforcer, who works with him, then hunts him.
stages.whoB: A favorite of the Grandmaster, whom she hunts when he flees.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Valkyrie beats Loki in a fight on Sakaar after he digs into her memories of the Valkyrior's slaughter. They end up on the same side, helping Thor and the Asgardians escape Hela.
stages.whoA: The Valkyrie who beats him in a fight, then fights on his side.
stages.whoB: Thor's brother, who digs into her memories. She beats him, then sides with him.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Loki tracks down Victor Timely, a variant of He Who Remains, and brings him to the TVA to fix the failing Temporal Loom. When the Loom tears Victor apart, Loki relives the moment again and again trying to save him.
stages.whoA: A variant of He Who Remains he brings to fix the Loom.
stages.whoB: The god who brings him to the Loom and keeps trying to save him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Lonnie Lincoln, the crime boss Tombstone, dangles Peter Parker off a skyscraper. Peter turns the fight around, webs him to a wall and hands the police the evidence to convict him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him to a wall and hands police the evidence.
stages.whoB: The crime boss Tombstone, who dangles him off a skyscraper.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Lorelei taunts Melinda May for losing Grant Ward to her spell, telling her that people can't always get what they want, though Lorelei can. May then has to fight the enchanted Ward aboard the Bus.
stages.whoA: The agent she taunts for losing Ward to her spell.
stages.whoB: The Asgardian who enchants Ward and taunts her for losing him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson's team joins Sif to track down Lorelei after she escapes Asgard and starts enslaving men on Earth. They catch up with her aboard the Bus, where Sif finally collars her.
stages.whoA: The agent whose team helps Sif catch her.
stages.whoB: An Asgardian fugitive his team helps Sif catch.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Lady Sif chases Lorelei from Asgard to Earth to bring her back to prison.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian who chases her down to bring her back to prison.
stages.whoB: The prisoner she chases to Earth to bring back.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Love is the daughter of Gorr, who asks Thor to look after her with his dying wish. Thor adopts her and raises her.
stages.whoA: Her adoptive father, who raises her at her father's dying wish.
stages.whoB: His adopted daughter, Gorr's child.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Lowak is one of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.
stages.whoA: A descendant who sees her story in visions.
stages.whoB: One of her Choctaw ancestors, seen in visions.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Lowak is Tuklo's ancestor, and her spirit echoes down the generations to reach her. When Tuklo struggles to prove herself and the Lighthorsemen are captured, Lowak and Chafa appear to her and give her the strength to rescue them.
stages.whoA: Her descendant, whom she gives the strength to rescue the Lighthorsemen.
stages.whoB: Her ancestor, whose spirit gives her strength to rescue the Lighthorsemen.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Lucian tries to kill Stephen Strange, and Strange kills him in their fight in the New York Sanctum.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer he tries to kill, who kills him.
stages.whoB: A Zealot who tries to kill him, whom he kills in the Sanctum.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Lucy Bauer's touch infects Melinda May with visions that drive her to paranoia.
stages.whoA: The agent her touch drives to paranoia.
stages.whoB: The ghost whose touch drives her to paranoia.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Lucy Bauer, a ghostly scientist chasing the Darkhold, finds that her fear-inducing touch has no effect on Ghost Rider. He stops her at the Roxxon power plant and destroys her.
stages.whoA: Ghost Rider, immune to her touch, who destroys her.
stages.whoB: The ghost scientist chasing the Darkhold, whom he destroys.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Luis is Scott Lang's best friend and former cellmate, and he brings Scott in on the heist at Hank Pym's house.
stages.whoA: His best friend and old cellmate, whom he brings in on the heist.
stages.whoB: His best friend and old cellmate, who brings him in on the heist.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Luis and Scott run X-Con Security together, and Luis works hard to land the big client that will keep their struggling business afloat.
stages.whoA: His best friend and business partner at X-Con Security.
stages.whoB: His best friend and business partner at X-Con Security.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Sonny Burch captures Luis and doses him with truth serum to find Hank Pym's lab.
stages.whoA: The arms dealer who captures him and doses him with truth serum.
stages.whoB: Scott's partner, whom he captures and doses with truth serum.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Uzman injects Luis with his truth serum so Sonny Burch can learn where Scott is hiding. Luis later turns the serum on Burch's crew, making them confess their crimes as the police arrive.
stages.whoA: Burch's man, who injects him with the truth serum he later turns on them.
stages.whoB: Scott's partner, whom he injects with truth serum.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah Dillard is Cottonmouth's cousin and a Harlem councilwoman. After his death she takes over his crime business, and Luke fights her for control of the neighborhood.
stages.whoA: Cottonmouth's cousin, who takes over his business, whom he fights for Harlem.
stages.whoB: The man she fights for control of Harlem after Cottonmouth dies.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Luke and Mariah keep up their war over Harlem until she dies, leaving him her club, Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoA: His rival for Harlem, who leaves him her club when she dies.
stages.whoB: Her rival for Harlem, to whom she leaves Harlem's Paradise.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Luke Cage and Matt Murdock are brought together by the Hand and fight side by side as the Defenders. When Midland Circle collapses, Luke and the others believe Matt has died there.
stages.whoA: A fellow Defender he believes dies at Midland Circle.
stages.whoB: A fellow Defender against the Hand.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty Knight is a Harlem detective who sleeps with Luke Cage on the night they first meet, then investigates him before coming to trust him. In time they grow into friends and allies against Harlem's crime bosses.
stages.whoA: A Harlem detective who investigates him, then becomes a friend and ally.
stages.whoB: A man she sleeps with, investigates, then comes to trust.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles recruits Luke Cage for the CIA. Luke accepts the offer to keep Jessica Jones and their daughter off the agency's radar.
stages.whoA: The CIA man who recruits him.
stages.whoB: A recruit who joins the CIA to keep his family safe.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Luke Cage trades blows with Murakami in the Hand's ambushes, launching him across the hood of a car. As the Defenders escape Midland Circle, Luke and Danny knock Murakami off the elevator.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader he fights and knocks off the elevator.
stages.whoB: A Defender who throws him across a car and off an elevator.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Pop gives Luke a job sweeping at his barber shop. He is a father figure and a friend, and his murder pushes Luke to become Harlem's hero.
stages.whoA: His friend and father figure, whose murder makes him Harlem's hero.
stages.whoB: A man he hires to sweep his shop and looks after.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Inspector Priscilla Ridley leads the Harlem precinct while Luke operates outside the law, and she treats him as a problem to be dealt with.
stages.whoA: The precinct inspector who treats him as a problem.
stages.whoB: A man outside the law she treats as a problem.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Detective Rafael Scarfe is corrupt, but after Cottonmouth's people shoot him, Luke protects him so his evidence can reach the police.
stages.whoA: A corrupt detective he protects so his evidence reaches the police.
stages.whoB: The man who protects him so his evidence can reach the police.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Luke is Reva Connors's widower, and her death at Jessica Jones's hands haunts him.
stages.whoA: His late wife, whose death haunts him.
stages.whoB: Her widower.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Luke met Reva while he was an inmate at Seagate Prison, where she ran counseling sessions, and they fell in love there.
stages.whoA: His late wife, whom he met and loved at Seagate.
stages.whoB: Her husband, whom she fell for while counseling him at Seagate.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Rosalie Carbone is a mob boss who moves in on Harlem during Mariah Dillard's war. Once Luke Cage takes over Harlem's Paradise, she deals with him as the new power in town.
stages.whoA: A mob boss who deals with him as Harlem's new power.
stages.whoB: The new power in Harlem, whom she does business with.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades is a former fellow inmate of Luke's at Seagate. He becomes Mariah Dillard's right-hand man and Luke's enemy.
stages.whoA: An old Seagate inmate, now Mariah's right-hand man.
stages.whoB: A fellow Seagate inmate, now his enemy.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Sowande fights Luke Cage and the Defenders. Luke captures him for questioning.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader he captures for questioning.
stages.whoB: A Defender who captures him for questioning.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Stick briefs Luke Cage and the other Defenders on the Hand's history.
stages.whoA: The old man who briefs the Defenders on the Hand.
stages.whoB: A Defender he briefs on the Hand's history.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tilda Johnson treats Luke's concussion at her herbal shop while he hunts Bushmaster, and he pulls her and her mother Mariah Dillard out of a burning building. She later poisons Mariah and turns on Luke when Mariah leaves Harlem's Paradise to him instead of her.
stages.whoA: Mariah's daughter, who treats him, then turns on him.
stages.whoB: The man she treats, then turns on when Mariah leaves him her club.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Tone, one of Cottonmouth's enforcers, pats Luke down before his sit-down with Cottonmouth. He then shoots up Pop's barbershop to get Chico Diaz, killing Pop and starting Luke's war with Cottonmouth, while Luke shields Lonnie Wilson from the bullets.
stages.whoA: The enforcer whose shooting of the barbershop kills Pop.
stages.whoB: The man he pats down, whose war he starts by killing Pop.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett is a Harlem hustler whom Luke keeps shaking down for information.
stages.whoA: A hustler he keeps shaking down for information.
stages.whoB: The man who keeps shaking him down for information.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip is one of Cottonmouth's enforcers, shaking down Connie Lin for campaign donations until Luke breaks up his crew. He keeps working against Luke as he moves from Cottonmouth to Shades and then to Diamondback.
stages.whoA: An enforcer whose crew he breaks up, who keeps working against him.
stages.whoB: The man who breaks up his crew and whom he keeps fighting.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt Murdock is Luke Jacobson's lawyer and a client of his tailoring. As Daredevil, he rescues Luke from Leap-Frog.
stages.whoA: His lawyer and client, who as Daredevil rescues him.
stages.whoB: His tailor and client, whom he rescues as Daredevil.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki Ramos persuades the tailor Luke Jacobson to make a superhero suit for Jennifer.
stages.whoA: The paralegal who talks him into making Jen's suit.
stages.whoB: The tailor she talks into making Jennifer a suit.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Lylla is a fellow test subject of the High Evolutionary and Rocket's first real friend. Rocket loses her when they try to escape from the High Evolutionary.
stages.whoA: Her first real friend, a fellow test subject.
stages.whoB: His first real friend, a fellow test subject he loses.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Lylla and Teefs are cage mates and friends in the High Evolutionary's Batch 89.
stages.whoA: A cage mate and friend in Batch 89.
stages.whoB: A cage mate and friend in Batch 89.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary experiments on Lylla and shoots her dead when Rocket tries to free Batch 89.
stages.whoA: Her captor, who experiments on her and shoots her dead.
stages.whoB: A test subject he experiments on and shoots dead.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia brings the last Heart-Shaped Herb to M'Baku, hoping he will use it to overthrow Erik Killmonger. Instead he shows her that the Jabari have been keeping T'Challa alive, and his warriors later join the fight.
stages.whoA: A spy who brings him the Herb, whom he shows T'Challa alive.
stages.whoB: The Jabari leader she brings the Herb to, who has saved T'Challa.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku and Okoye end up on the same side against Erik Killmonger. When W'Kabi charges M'Baku with a war rhino, Okoye steps in front of the animal and stops it.
stages.whoA: The general who stops a war rhino charging him.
stages.whoB: The Jabari leader she saves from a war rhino.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku challenges Ramonda's son for the throne, but later takes her in when she flees Erik Killmonger and keeps her safe in Jabariland.
stages.whoA: The queen mother he shelters in Jabariland.
stages.whoB: Her son's challenger, who later shelters her from Killmonger.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: When Ramonda rules Wakanda, M'Baku sits on her council, where she has to rein in his quarrels with Okoye.
stages.whoA: His queen, who reins in his quarrels on her council.
stages.whoB: A council member whose quarrels with Okoye she reins in.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku mocks Shuri as a child who scoffs at tradition when he challenges T'Challa, but he later shelters her family and fights beside her.
stages.whoA: The princess he mocks, then shelters and fights beside.
stages.whoB: The Jabari leader who mocks her, then shelters her family.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: After T'Challa's death, M'Baku becomes one of Shuri's firmest backers. When she steps away, he announces that he will challenge for the throne.
stages.whoA: The princess he backs after T'Challa's death, until she steps away.
stages.whoB: One of her firmest backers, who claims the throne when she steps away.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku challenges T'Challa for the throne in ritual combat and loses, and T'Challa spares him. When Killmonger takes over, M'Baku shelters the wounded T'Challa and brings his Jabari warriors to help win Wakanda back.
stages.whoA: The king who spares him in combat, whom he later shelters.
stages.whoB: His challenger, whom he spares and who shelters him in turn.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi cheers T'Challa on when M'Baku challenges him for the throne. After W'Kabi sides with Erik Killmonger, M'Baku's Jabari smash his tribe's shield line, and W'Kabi tries to run M'Baku down with a war rhino until Okoye stops it.
stages.whoA: Killmonger's ally, who tries to run him down with a war rhino.
stages.whoB: The Jabari leader whose warriors smash his shield line.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Spider-Man breaks up Mac Gargan's weapons deal on the Staten Island Ferry.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who breaks up his ferry weapons deal.
stages.whoB: An arms buyer whose ferry deal he breaks up.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Gargan returns as the Scorpion and fights Spider-Man again.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom he fights again as the Scorpion.
stages.whoB: The Scorpion, whom he fights again.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Mac Gargan asks Adrian Toomes in prison about Spider-Man's identity, and Toomes refuses to tell him.
stages.whoA: A fellow inmate who won't tell him who Spider-Man is.
stages.whoB: A fellow inmate who asks him who Spider-Man is.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Madame Gao runs a heroin operation in Hell's Kitchen as one of Fisk's partners, and Daredevil works to bring it down.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, who works to bring down her heroin trade.
stages.whoB: Fisk's partner, whose heroin trade he works to bring down.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Gao turns out to be one of the leaders of the Hand, and Daredevil and the Defenders fight her in the battle for Midland Circle.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, a Defender she fights at Midland Circle.
stages.whoB: A Hand leader he fights at Midland Circle.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Madame Gao and Murakami are two of the five founders of the Hand, who left K'un-Lun together in search of immortality. They work side by side in New York to dig beneath Midland Circle, and both end up buried there when it collapses.
stages.whoA: A fellow Hand founder from K'un-Lun, buried with her at Midland Circle.
stages.whoB: A fellow Hand founder who left K'un-Lun with him.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Madame Gao and Sowande are two of the five founders of the Hand. When Sowande's men open fire on the Defenders, Gao shoots one of them herself and orders Sowande to stop, since they need the Iron Fist alive.
stages.whoA: A fellow Hand founder, whom she orders to hold fire.
stages.whoB: A fellow Hand founder, who stops his men firing on the Defenders.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Madame Gao is one of the five leaders of the Hand, the order Stick has fought for generations. Her soldiers and Sowande's surround Stick and the Defenders at the Royal Dragon.
stages.whoA: The Hand's longtime foe, whom her soldiers surround.
stages.whoB: A Hand leader, of the order he has fought for generations.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Madame Gao agrees with Leland Owlsley that Vanessa is distracting Fisk. Together they arrange for her to be poisoned.
stages.whoA: Fisk's love, whose poisoning she arranges with Owlsley.
stages.whoB: Wilson's partner, who arranges her poisoning with Owlsley.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Madame Gao is one of Fisk's partners in his criminal alliance. Their partnership turns cold when Fisk's focus shifts to Vanessa and his own plans.
stages.whoA: Her partner in the alliance, who grows distant over Vanessa.
stages.whoB: A partner in his alliance, who cools on him over Vanessa.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Zhou Cheng is a Hand warrior loyal to Madame Gao who guards her compound in Anzhou, China. When Danny Rand beats him in single combat, Gao steps out to face Danny herself.
stages.whoA: A Hand warrior loyal to her, who guards her Anzhou compound.
stages.whoB: His master, whose compound he guards in Anzhou.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Madeline Stanton is Ronnie's friend, and they talk about how Riri is coping with grief.
stages.whoA: Her friend, Riri's mother, with whom she talks about Riri's grief.
stages.whoB: Her friend, who talks with her about Riri's grief.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Madeline Stanton is Zelma's mother, a former Master of the Mystic Arts who left Kamar-Taj for Chicago to raise her. She teaches Zelma magic, though Zelma also studies it on her own.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, whom she teaches magic.
stages.whoB: Her mother, a former sorcerer who teaches her magic.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Madisynn King is Wong's friend and roommate after he rescues her from a magic act gone wrong. They watch television together at Kamar-Taj.
stages.whoA: Her friend and roommate, who rescued her from a magic act.
stages.whoB: His friend and roommate, whom he rescued from a magic act.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Sister Maggie Grace is Matt's mother. She left him as a baby to become a nun, and nurses him back to health years later.
stages.whoA: Her son, whom she left as a baby and nurses back to health.
stages.whoB: His mother, a nun who left him as a baby, then nurses him.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Maggie Lang is Scott Lang's ex-wife and Cassie's mother. They stay on friendly terms for Cassie's sake.
stages.whoA: Her ex-husband and Cassie's father.
stages.whoB: His ex-wife and Cassie's mother.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Makkari rescues Phastos from the Domo, and they fight side by side to stop the Emergence.
stages.whoA: A fellow Eternal she rescues and fights beside.
stages.whoB: A fellow Eternal who rescues him from the Domo.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sersi finds Makkari aboard the Domo and brings her into the fight to stop the Emergence.
stages.whoA: The Eternal who brings her into the fight.
stages.whoB: A fellow Eternal she finds on the Domo and brings into the fight.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Makkari fights beside Thena in the Eternals. During one of Thena's Mahd Wy'ry attacks, Thena nearly kills her.
stages.whoA: A fellow Eternal who nearly kills her in a Mahd Wy'ry fit.
stages.whoB: A fellow Eternal she nearly kills in a Mahd Wy'ry attack.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Malcolm Ducasse and Trish Walker are both close to Jessica, and they work together to stop her from giving herself up to Kilgrave.
stages.whoA: Jessica's sister, with whom he keeps her from giving herself up.
stages.whoB: Jessica's friend, with whom she keeps her from giving herself up.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm and Trish become lovers, but Trish pushes him to use an enhancer inhaler and later knocks him out to take Karl Malus for herself.
stages.whoA: His lover, who pushes him to the inhaler, then knocks him out.
stages.whoB: Her lover, whom she pushes to the inhaler, then knocks out.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Once Trish becomes a killer vigilante, Malcolm wants her stopped, and he helps Jessica trap her.
stages.whoA: His ex, a killer vigilante he helps Jessica trap.
stages.whoB: Her ex, who helps Jessica trap her.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Malekith fought Odin's father Bor. Then he attacks Odin's Asgard to take back the Aether.
stages.whoA: The king whose Asgard he attacks for the Aether.
stages.whoB: His father's old enemy, who attacks Asgard for the Aether.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Malekith fights Thor across the Convergence in Greenwich, and Thor kills him there.
stages.whoA: The god who kills him in Greenwich.
stages.whoB: The Dark Elf he kills during the Convergence.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Mallory Book represents Craig Hollis, Mr. Immortal, when his many ex-wives come after his money. After he leaps out of her office window to prove he cannot die, she negotiates his dispute with his ex-spouses.
stages.whoA: Her client, who leaps out her window to prove he can't die.
stages.whoB: His lawyer, who settles his dispute with his ex-wives.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki Ramos and Mallory Book work together on Mr. Immortal's divorce case at GLK&H. While they celebrate the win, they stumble onto Intelligencia's plan to attack Jennifer.
stages.whoA: A colleague on the Mr. Immortal case, with whom she finds Intelligencia's plan.
stages.whoB: A colleague on the Mr. Immortal case, with whom she finds Intelligencia's plan.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Mallory Book faces Titania in court on Jennifer's behalf and calls her beauty products a scam.
stages.whoA: The influencer she faces in court and calls a scam.
stages.whoB: Jennifer's lawyer, who faces her in court and calls her products a scam.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Mallory Book briefly represents Todd Phelps as a client before he is exposed as HulkKing.
stages.whoA: A brief client, before he is exposed as HulkKing.
stages.whoB: His lawyer, briefly, before he is exposed.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Man-Bull and Saracen are both members of Emil Blonsky's retreat. In one group session, Saracen raises his hand to point out that Man-Bull and Águila have been spending a lot of time together, which he finds concerning.
stages.whoA: A fellow member of Blonsky's retreat, who flags him and Águila.
stages.whoB: A fellow member of Blonsky's retreat, whose closeness to Águila worries him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mantis kicks Master Karja to the ground when his Orgosentries corner her and Drax at the Orgoscope. Karja shoots Drax and forces her to surrender, until Peter Quill hacks his suit and frees them.
stages.whoA: The Orgocorp chief she kicks down, who forces her surrender.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who kicks him down before he forces her to surrender.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula and Mantis meet when Ego brings Mantis to the Guardians, and they become teammates after his defeat.
stages.whoA: A teammate she meets through Ego.
stages.whoB: A teammate she meets when Ego brings her to the Guardians.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: On Titan, Mantis startles Peter Parker by reaching out to put him to sleep, and he webs her up in fear. They then fight Thanos together, and Peter webs her to safety when the battle turns.
stages.whoA: A young hero who webs her up in fright, then saves her.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who startles him on Titan, then fights Thanos beside him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis serves Ego and comes to the Guardians with him, then warns them about his plans and fights beside them to stop him.
stages.whoA: Ego's son, whom she warns about his father and fights beside.
stages.whoB: Ego's servant, who warns him of his plans and fights beside him.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Mantis tells Peter Quill she is his half-sister, since they share Ego as their father.
stages.whoA: Her half-brother, through their father Ego.
stages.whoB: His half-sister, through their father Ego.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis joins the Guardians after Ego's defeat, and when she first sees Rocket she thinks he is a pet and asks to pat him.
stages.whoA: A teammate she mistakes for a pet and asks to pat.
stages.whoB: A new teammate who mistakes him for a pet.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Mantis and Stephen Strange meet in a standoff on Titan before teaming up against Thanos. Strange opens a portal to drop her onto Thanos's head so she can put him into a trance.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who portals her onto Thanos's head.
stages.whoB: A Guardian he drops onto Thanos's head to put him in a trance.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Mantis nearly holds Thanos down on Titan, and she is later wiped out by the snap.
stages.whoA: The titan she nearly holds down, before the snap wipes her out.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who nearly holds him down on Titan.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary captures Mantis with Drax and Nebula and orders them fed to his Abilisks. Mantis calms the beasts instead, and she helps the Guardians bring him down.
stages.whoA: Her captor, who orders her fed to his Abilisks.
stages.whoB: A Guardian he orders fed to his Abilisks, who calms them.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Mar-Vell lives on Earth as Dr. Wendy Lawson and runs Project Pegasus, where Maria Rambeau serves under her. Maria later learns Lawson was really a Kree scientist trying to end the war with the Skrulls.
stages.whoA: A pilot who serves under her at Project Pegasus.
stages.whoB: Her boss at Project Pegasus, secretly a Kree scientist.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: After Mar-Vell betrays the Kree, Minn-Erva and Yon-Rogg track her down and shoot her test plane out of the sky.
stages.whoA: A Starforce soldier who shoots her plane from the sky.
stages.whoB: The Kree traitor she shoots out of the sky.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Mar-Vell is a top Kree scientist who turns against the Kree Empire to help the Skrulls. The Supreme Intelligence sends Starforce to stop her, and later wears her face when it speaks to Carol.
stages.whoA: The Kree ruler she turns against, which sends Starforce after her.
stages.whoB: A top Kree scientist who turns traitor. It wears her face for Carol.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Yon-Rogg kills Mar-Vell, his former comrade, after she rebels against the Kree.
stages.whoA: Her former comrade, who kills her.
stages.whoB: His former comrade, whom he kills for rebelling.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Randall Spector is Marc's younger brother. Randall drowns as a child, and their mother blames Marc for his death.
stages.whoA: His younger brother, who drowns as a child.
stages.whoB: His older brother, whom their mother blames for his death.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Taweret is the hippo goddess who guides Marc and Steven through the Duat. She helps Marc escape the afterlife to stop Harrow.
stages.whoA: The hippo goddess who guides him through the Duat.
stages.whoB: A soul she guides through the Duat and helps escape.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson protects Audrey Nathan from Marcus Daniels and helps bring him down.
stages.whoA: The agent who protects Audrey from him and brings him down.
stages.whoB: The man he protects Audrey from and helps bring down.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Governor Marge McCaffrey works to remove Fisk from office, and Matt fights to keep her safe and to use her help in court.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who keeps her safe and uses her help in court.
stages.whoB: The governor he protects, who works to remove Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Governor Marge McCaffrey and the CIA operative Mr. Charles become allies of convenience.
stages.whoA: A CIA operative who is her ally of convenience.
stages.whoB: The governor who is his ally of convenience.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Governor Marge McCaffrey is Sheila Rivera's former boss and her friend.
stages.whoA: Her former employee and friend.
stages.whoB: Her former boss and friend.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Governor Marge McCaffrey stands against Mayor Wilson Fisk's grab for power over New York City.
stages.whoA: The mayor whose power grab she stands against.
stages.whoB: The governor who stands against his grab for power.
